title: MODFLOW6 XMI Package Adapter

canonical_reconciliation.head: 1604b89e6bebf6436dcd2718b8e150bf909d8a01
canonical_reconciliation.relevant_delta: No canonical movement during F-GC35 implementation/qualification.

imod_coupler.evidence: API package exposes NODELIST/HCOF/RHS/MAXBOUND/NBOUND; API package update follows mf6.prepare_time_step; NODELIST has a pre-prepare dummy/allocation caveat.

xmipy.evidence: get_var_address resolves kernel variable addresses; get_value_ptr returns live ctypes-backed array views; prepare_time_step is a separate host lifecycle call.

qualified_contract: exact XMI address acquisition for NODELIST, HCOF, RHS, MAXBOUND and NBOUND
initial acquisition after MODFLOW initialize does not open publication
all five live pointer views are reacquired after each host prepare_time_step
post-prepare pointer validation requires positive MAXBOUND, scalar MAXBOUND/NBOUND, adequate array capacity and compatible exposed dtypes
pre-prepare stale/dummy NODELIST cannot be forwarded to the publisher after refresh
bindings and F-GC33 terms are forwarded to the injected F-GC34 publisher by identity without transformation
live NODELIST/HCOF/RHS/NBOUND views are forwarded by identity without copying
current timestep generation must have one successful F-GC34 publication before close_before_prepare_solve succeeds
a previous timestep publication cannot satisfy the next timestep generation
failed F-GC34 status does not satisfy the solve-boundary guard
adapter contains no calls to initialize, prepare_time_step, prepare_solve, solve, finalize_solve, finalize_time_step or finalize
adapter has no Ribasim or SWAP commit dependency

failed_iteration.head: 16101e4cd79b8eedca9e61a64e2f079ac44b544b
failed_iteration.disposition: Standalone importlib test loader did not register the module in sys.modules before dataclass evaluation. Test infrastructure only; adapter code and lifecycle/XMI contract were unchanged.

evidence_boundary.qualified: XMI API shape, live-view reacquisition contract, publication timing guard and injected F-GC34 publisher seam against a deterministic mock XMI kernel.
not_yet_qualified: actual xmipy NumPy pointer views in a live MODFLOW model
concrete cross-language bridge invoking the Fortran F-GC34 routine
end-to-end MODFLOW solve with SWAP5 tangent terms

next_permitted_action: A separately bounded live-kernel integration workunit: provide a concrete F-GC34 callable bridge and run a minimal MODFLOW6 API-package smoke test through xmipy, while keeping solve orchestration external.
